citation: NASA LRO LOLA + JAXA Kaguya TC merged DEM, 512 ppd (~59 m/px)
grid: azimuthal equidistant about the site, resampled bilinear
resolution_note: source product is 59.225 m/px; this 512px grid at 4 m/px spans 34.6 source posts and is a 15x bilinear resampling of them — interpolation, not added detail
note: Steep downhill; the scenario is braking, so the patch is chosen for grade and the traverse runs down the fall line.
